quest.title: Memory's Final Chapter
quest.description: Though lost memories flow by like water, friendships may be reborn with time...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Mora x10000

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: "The pomegranate sings, the apples clap..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello, Mr. Khayyam! What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Oh, hello, hello. Child in white, and... *sigh* Apologies, my children. My memories are getting blurry, and names just fade after a while...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #Just call me {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Haha... Okay, so you were the...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes! We were the Javans - the brave young ones!

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Hmm... So, please tell me, do the Aranara still remember me? Do they remember us all?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, uh...

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: I see... But I can't see them anymore, nor can I know how much they miss me... What a pity.

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Hehe... I can't see them anymore. I am too old to see their faces or hear their voices... Gone, it's all gone.

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: *cough*... Apologies, I have to take my leave now. Perhaps a miracle is my only hope...

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: One cannot understand or chase after a miracle. The only thing one can do is wait.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... We can befriend them all over again!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Hi, Golden Nara and White Floaty.

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Thank you. I can't remember the past, but trusty friends, you surely are.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: #Aranaga, {M#he}{F#she}'s here, they're here!

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Yeah, here, they're here!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: #Here you are, Nara {NICKNAME}, White Floaty. Welcome you, the three of us.

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Here comes the moon. Now, is the time to plant flowers. Are you ready?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I am ready.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon too!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: So... Aranakin, Aragaru, let's start the ritual.

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: "Be back home, be back home, dreams of the garden, memories of the forest..."

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: "Embrace, let us:"

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: "Deeper dreams, everlasting happiness."

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: "Rejoice, let us:"

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: "The pomegranate sings, the apples clap!"

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The Aranara plant the dried flowers. With the ballad echoing in the wind, the flowers come back to life magically...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... The three flowers are alive again!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Yes, because benevolent, Mawtiyima is. So, she gives memories a chance to resurrect.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Yeah! Even if we forget about you, the memories will... Hmm, be woven into the leaf veins and roots, turn into leaves, turn into tree rings!

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Or turn into fatty worms, eaten by other worms. Other worms make things that nourish the plants, and make us grow!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... You still can't recall anything about us, right?

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Yes... Because, memories don't belong to you and me... The stories from the past, we have shared with all grass and trees in the forest...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: But it doesn't matter, because we are new friends now, right?

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Yeah! New friends!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Hello, new friends!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Hope you'll always remember our song!

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: #Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME} and White Floaty!

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: We must hang out like this in the future, too!
